component.name: bindaru
component.summary: Find, install and remove software from the Arch repositories and the AUR

description.p: bindaru is a software store for Arch-based systems: search the official repositories and the AUR, read what a package is, and install or remove it in a click.
It follows the uQ theme and shows clear reasons when pacman fails.
Follows uQ's Reduce motion, and uses uQ's shared theme base and type scale.
Problems are reported to uQ: a crash leaves a record uQ lists on Settings › Problems, and the window's startup failure has a code (BINDARU-001) that uqctl explain describes.
Hovers, fades and slides move at the same speeds and curve as the uQ desktop.
Follows uQ's theme with a file watch instead of a one-second check, and lists under Settings and Package Manager only.
One window per session: a second start brings the open window forward.
Says why pacman failed, and no longer hangs after steps that need root.
